description.narrative: Ambassaden ska genomföra en insats i syfte att främja jämställdhet och kvinnors rättigheter i Etiopien. Insatsen består i att etablera och lansera ett nätverk, ha runda bordssamtal samt erbjuda musik av en etiopisk artist. Insatsen ska genomföras den 8 mars 2018. Detta beslut omfattar att handla upp en artist som ska framföra musiken under kvällen samt musikutrustning plus tält, bord och infravärme för att genomföra rundabordssamtalen utomhus på kvällen.

The Embassy is planning for an intervention the 8 March with the aim to strengthen gender equality and women's rights. The contribution will consist of the establishment and launch of a gender equality network, round table discussions and entertainment. The contribution shall be implemented the 8 March 2018. This decision includes the procurement of music and music equipment for the evening.

sector.narrative: Women’s rights organisations and movements, and government institutions

description.narrative: The purpose with the intervention was to establish a gender equality network attached to the Embassy of Sweden, launch the network during an event the 7th of May. During the event a round table discussion would take place and entertainment would be provided. All the results are achieved; Network established and launched. The event with round table discussions and entertainment was carried out.
